comment: role: 'source' owns the libraries (guides/templates/rules/prompts) and syncs them two-way; 'consumer' (default) reads them from the global store and never copies the markdown in. project: null = derive from git remote/folder. global_dir: null = %USERPROFILE%\.clutch. stack: rule-file names for the bundle (e.g. ["python","fastapi"]); the ai/ set is always included.
